note: Ratchet for `scripts/loc-metrics.py`. Every number below is lines of git-tracked source, classified by the lexer in `scripts/lib/loc_classify.py`. They may only go DOWN — raising a limit to make a build green defeats the point of measuring, so a rise fails the gate. When a rise is deliberate, run `scripts/loc-metrics.py --baseline` and commit the new file in the SAME commit that grew the tree. Generated files (`@generated` / `DO NOT EDIT` in the header) are measured but excluded from these limits, because appending a wire kind must never fail a size gate. The `*.comment` numbers are measured and diffed but NOT gated: a gate that makes deleting documentation the cheapest way to go green is pointed at the wrong thing.
measured: 2026-08-06 on the merged round-2 tree, after the review follow-ups. Total code 167,711 -> 158,551: -9,160, -5.46%. The rises since the pre-review stamp are regression tests the round-2 review found missing -- the tombstone persist failures that would otherwise resurrect a deleted world, the worker log pump surviving a non-UTF-8 line, and the SpawnedService requirement flag proving a missing binary fails rather than skips -- plus the try_persist seam those tests needed. A size gate that charges for a regression test is pointed at the wrong thing. Re-measured on the merge commit, never merged from a branch.
